method: Independent continuous resistance-coordinate manufactured field and volume-averaged source, sparse physical FV steady solve; actual product rate and one-step check at each separately solved steady state. This is not a product time-to-steady run.
continuousField: T=300+2 cos(pi*x/L)*f(y); f linear in integrated 1/k resistance coordinate with 2R jumps normalized by total resistance. Solid source=-k*(Txx+Tyy), fluid source=rho*cp*u*Tx-k*Tyy. Source u*f cell integral by four-point Gauss; x sine/cosine means analytic.
